results.title: Magna International (NYSE:MGA) Price Target Raised to $77.00
results.description: Magna International (NYSE:MGA – Free Report) (TSE:MG) had its price target increased by JPMorgan Chase & Co. from $70.00 to $77.00 in a report published on Monday,Benzinga reports.
